title: Agent verdict
description: A camera agent's judgment on whether a relayed subject appeared here. On 'match' the agent also sends a new relay to the next camera. Producer/owner: Wali (agents). Contract v0.1.

ts.description: Seconds on the run clock (replay: video time; live: unix epoch).

run_id.description: Optional: groups events from one replay/live run.

source.description: Optional: component that emitted it, e.g. 'perception'.

camera_id.description: Camera ID, e.g. 'cam_03'. Must exist in cameras.json.

evidence_event_ids.description: event_ids of earlier events that justify this one (the receipts trail).
